description: Newest value of one measure (World Bank code, eurostat.*, ecb.*, f.*) for every member of a country group, highest first. period "common" puts every row on one period (members without it in missing). top (1-50) ranks the members and returns the first N, each row with its rank (order desc or asc). Example: {"indicator":"SP.POP.TOTL","group":"G20","period":"common"}. Over time: places (up to 30) or group with from/to/last gives one row per period, one column per place: {"indicator":"SP.POP.TOTL","places":"DE,FR,IT","from":"2010"}.
name: get_table
title: Get a country group table
